description: JSON-spec SVG chart library. Round 7 benchmarks, including losses, are in catalog/content/benchmarks.md.
rules: Prefer the JSON spec over React component props such as dataKey.
Cite benchmark losses as well as wins. The numbers are in catalog/content/benchmarks.md.
a11y.alt is required. Tooltip, zoom, pan, brush, and animation run in @chartkitdev/core/interact when the spec sets them. The static SVG does not paint them.
